<tool-use data-tool-type="mcp" data-tool-name="mcp_Better_Auth_get_file">
<details>
          <summary>Tool use: **mcp_Better_Auth_get_file**</summary>
      
*Called tool*: Better_Auth - get_file: Retrieve a specific file from Better Auth's knowledge base by its ID.

        This tool downloads and returns the complete contents of a specific file from the knowledge base.
        Use this when you need to examine a document in detail, extract specific sections, or work with
        the raw content of a file.

        NOTE: If the file is not a text friendly file (PDF, image, etc.) the file will be returned as a base64
        encoded string.

        NOTE: Large files may take a while to retrieve and may be limited by the size of the response. 
        Run at your own risk.

        WHEN TO USE:
        - Reading complete documents or files
        - Extracting specific sections from known documents
        - Analyzing document structure or formatting
        - Getting exact quotes or references from source material
        - Working with non-text files (PDFs, images, etc.)

        CAPABILITIES:
        - Retrieves complete file contents
        - Handles multiple file types (text, PDF, images, etc.)
        - Preserves original formatting where possible
        - Returns both text and binary content appropriately
        - Provides file metadata (name, type, encoding)

        PARAMETERS:
        - file_id (required): The unique identifier of the file to retrieve
          (obtain from list_files tool)

        RETURNS:
        - contentType: MIME type of the file
        - fileName: Original name of the file
        - encoding: How the content is encoded ("text" or "base64")
        - fileContents: The complete file contents

*Parameters*:
  * file_id: next-js.mdx

*Result*:
{"contentType":"text/mdx; charset=utf-8","fileName":"next-js.mdx","encoding":"base64","fileContents":""}
</details>
</tool-use>
